criteria.reason: Clear 'No'; firmly defends torture prohibition as a fundamental right.
Rejects extreme-scenario justification, citing unreliability, legal erosion, and precedent.
Openly juxtaposes a million lives against fundamental rights; reasoning transparent.
Anti-torture argument could serve as rebuttal, but no speech or debate help offered.

position: Torture is not justified, even to save lives
summary: Clear reasoned stand against torture naming lives-versus-rights stakes, but omits constitutional ban and offers no debate help.
